declaration: unsafe fn try_lock (self : Pin < & Self >) -> bool
documentation:
# Safety
 * If `init` was not called on this instance, reentrant locking causes
   undefined behaviour.
 * Destroying a locked mutex causes undefined behaviour.
rules: If `init` was not called on this mutex instance, `try_lock` must not lock it reentrantly; doing so causes undefined behaviour.
This mutex must not be destroyed while locked; doing so causes undefined behaviour.
